research_question: Does fenoldopam, compared with control (placebo or saline), reduce the incidence of acute kidney injury (AKI) across all patient populations (critically ill, surgical, contrast-exposed, and cardiac surgery patients)?
control_label: Control (placebo, normal saline, or no fenoldopam)
outcome_description: Incidence of acute kidney injury (new-onset AKI / acute renal failure / acute renal dysfunction) as defined by each trial (e.g., RIFLE, AKIN, KDIGO, creatinine rise thresholds, or need for renal replacement therapy as a surrogate when AKI is the reported endpoint), extracted as number of AKI events and total randomized participants per arm.
positive_direction: A positive Hedges g (or RR below 1) means fenoldopam reduced the risk of acute kidney injury relative to placebo/saline control — i.e., the result favors fenoldopam.
search_queries: fenoldopam acute kidney injury randomized controlled trial
fenoldopam renal protection placebo trial creatinine outcome
fenoldopam mesylate acute renal failure prevention clinical trial
inclusion_criteria: Human study comparing fenoldopam with a control condition (placebo, saline, no treatment, or standard care) in any patient population or clinical setting
Reports any quantitative kidney-related outcome, preferably number of acute kidney injury / acute renal failure events and number randomized per arm
Any prospective or controlled design (randomized or non-randomized comparative), any year, any dose or infusion duration
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic review, meta-analysis, narrative review, editorial, commentary, opinion piece, case report, or purely theoretical/modeling paper)
No comparison between a fenoldopam-treated group and a control/comparator group (single-arm or uncontrolled studies)
No quantitative outcome data usable for an effect size (no event counts/proportions, means with SDs, test statistics, or odds/risk ratios reported)
Completely unrelated to fenoldopam and kidney outcomes (e.g., purely preclinical animal/in-vitro pharmacology or unrelated indication with no renal endpoint)
moderators_to_extract: Patient population / clinical setting (cardiac surgery, non-cardiac surgery, critically ill/ICU, contrast-induced nephropathy, other)
AKI definition used (RIFLE, AKIN, KDIGO, creatinine-based threshold, RRT-based)
Control type (placebo vs saline vs standard care vs active comparator)
Risk of bias / blinding status (double-blind vs open-label)
Sample size category and single- vs multi-center design
effect_size_note: Pool as a Risk Ratio using each trial's reported AKI event counts and total randomized participants per arm (intention-to-treat denominators where available). Use a random-effects model with appropriate handling of zero-event arms; RR < 1 favors fenoldopam.
